summary: Bay Management is evaluating a phased move from Yardi and BuildingLink to Entrata for a mixed portfolio. The first-property configuration should use conventional leasing—not student-by-the-bed—even where many residents are students. Key configuration themes are role-based access, broker attribution, controlled application and lease generation, waitlists, affordable compliance at Oxbow Farms, resident-facing events, inspections, make-ready workflows, and subsidy ledgers. Several premium products remain commercial decisions rather than settled settings.

settings.path: Setup >> Users & Groups >> Groups >> Add Group
settings.proposed: Create separate groups for Operations Administrators, Accounting Administrators, Property Managers, Leasing, Maintenance, Affordable Compliance, and Concierge/Front Desk.
settings.meaning: Each job type receives a reusable permission profile instead of permissions being managed independently for every employee.
settings.assumption: Named users and final membership will be collected during implementation.
reasoning: Bay Management needs different views for accounting, site operations, affordable compliance, maintenance, leasing, and front-desk employees.
The concierge/front-desk group must be much more restricted than managers and accounting users.

questions.question: Default: keep the current basic package-tracking workflow. Is automatic label-to-resident recognition mandatory before BuildingLink can be retired?

functionality.need: Manage resident guests, amenities, events, communications, incidents, and concierge tasks.
functionality.product: ResidentPortal, guest manager, amenity reservations, Message Center, contact points, and a restricted concierge role
